en.title: The Village of the Soughing Rain and the Final Passenger
en.premise: Returning to his hometown for a relative's funeral after several years, the protagonist finds himself witnessing a strange festival held by the village. It is said that on this night, a 'final train' appears only once a year, carrying passengers who do not belong to this world. When the etiquette of hospitality is breached, 'something' lurking in the village's silence begins to slowly creep toward his very feet.

zh.title: 啜雨之村与最后的乘客
zh.premise: 为了参加亲戚的葬礼，主角时隔多年回到了故乡，却恰逢村庄举行一场诡异的祭典。据说在那天深夜，一年一度出现的“末班列车”会载着不属于这个世界的乘客。一旦违背了款待的礼节，潜伏在村庄寂静之中的“某种东西”，便会悄无声息地向主角的脚下蔓延而来。
